verdict.rationale: Crossmint gives agents verifiable credentials only on the payment side. Each agent gets its own signer key bound to a user-signed, onchain-enforced permission set, and pays x402 endpoints with signed payment proofs. Agent cards run over Visa Intelligent Commerce and Mastercard Agent Pay network rails. These are signatures and network-verified credentials, but nothing in the docs describes them as a merchant-facing way to identify agents or tell trusted agents from anonymous bots. missing for 10: registered agent profiles or a registry merchants can query, trust tiers or reputation, explicit merchant-side agent verification docs, independent corroboration.
